Just graduated and have recently obtained your bachelor's degree? Interested in a leadership role? Our client, Katoen Natie in Ghent, has a vacancy for a Supply Chain Trainee.

 

 

Grow into a leadership position with the Supply Chain Traineeship

 

 

As a Supply Chain Trainee, you will have the opportunity to advance to a leadership role within one of our logistics operations within a span of 2 years. Your logistics career will take off with an extensive on-the-job training program lasting approximately 2 years. The emphasis is on developing operational skills, leadership qualities, and specialization.

 

A diverse journey.

 

 

Throughout this exploratory experience, you will have the chance to become familiar with various operations and clients. This will enable you to discover the possibilities available to you within the company. There will be a total of 4 evaluation moments during the program. Depending on your competencies and interests, you may progress to a leadership position, such as a team leader overseeing a team/department and being responsible for guiding and coaching your team within a specific department.

 

 

 

• You have obtained a bachelor's degree in logistics, business or business management, trade, etc.

• Or you have an A2 diploma with relevant work experience, such as team leader, shift leader, supervisor, logistics employee, forklift driver, ambitious warehouse employee, etc.

• You speak fluent English and Dutch

• You are a true people manager and enjoy leading others.

• You can remain calm in stressful situations and are willing to make decisions.

• You have a hands-on mentality and are willing to actively get things done.

• You are willing to invest in yourself, you are driven and eager to learn.

• You are flexible in terms of working hours (shifts) and tasks.

We are currently looking for a motivated Terberg - Tugmaster driver (CE driver) for internal transport at Katoen Natie Gent. In this role, you will be responsible for safely and efficiently carrying out internal transport using a Terberg - Tugmaster tractor. You will be involved in moving goods and materials within our logistics environment and ensuring they are delivered to the correct locations.

 

 

• Operating the Terberg - Tugmaster tractor to move goods and materials within the facility.

• Loading and unloading trucks using the Terberg - Tugmaster tractor.

• Carefully checking goods and materials to ensure they match the corresponding documentation.

• Recording completed tasks and keeping track of inventory levels.

• Compliance with safety regulations and ensuring a safe working environment.

 

 

 

• Demonstrable experience as a Terberg - Tugmaster driver or operating similar tractors.

• You have a valid CE driver's license and code 95.

• Knowledge of applicable laws and regulations regarding internal transport.

• Familiarity with safety regulations and the ability to apply them correctly.

• Good communication skills in Dutch and/or English to effectively interact with colleagues.

• You are motivated and reliable and value safety and quality.

• You are flexible regarding hours and tasks.

• Willingness to work in two shifts or nightshift

• Good physical condition and capable of performing prolonged seated work.

• Attention to detail and precise execution of tasks.

• Expirience with a forklift long vorks is a plus!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're seeking an experienced Warehouse Team Leader to join our operations team at our state-of-the-art facility in Gent Zeehaven. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll guide, inspire, and work alongside a dedicated team of warehouse professionals while ensuring operational excellence in our fast-paced international logistics environment.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Team Leadership: Coach and motivate warehouse staff to consistently achieve operational KPIs and quality standards

Operational Planning: Create efficient work schedules, allocate resources, and optimize workflow processes

Hands-On Management: Lead by example - work directly with your team using forklifts and warehouse equipment when needed

Performance Management: Monitor team performance, provide feedback, and implement improvement initiatives

Critical Decision Making: Make quick, effective decisions during peak periods and tight deadline situations

Safety & Compliance: Ensure all safety protocols and quality standards are maintained at all times

Reporting: Provide regular updates to warehouse supervisors and operational management

Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance efficiency and reduce operational costs

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

Essential Requirements:

3+ years of team leadership experience in warehouse, logistics, or distribution environments

Forklift certification (or commitment to obtain certification within 30 days)

Strong communication skills in Dutch and English (French is a plus)

Proven track record of meeting KPIs and managing operational deadlines

Physical stamina for hands-on warehouse work and extended periods on your feet

Flexible schedule - ability to work various shifts including occasional weekends

Problem-solving mindset with ability to make decisions under pressure

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or related field or equal through experience

Experience with WMS (Warehouse Management Systems)

Knowledge of customs procedures and international shipping

Lean/Six Sigma certification or continuous improvement experience

Multilingual capabilities for our international client base

Do you have experience as a forklift driver?As the driver of the forklift truck with long forks, you are responsible for storing goods and loading/unloading the trucks. In addition, you sometimes help with other tasks in the warehouse (order picking, receiving, stock counting, etc.). For this, you will use a scanner.You will start in the Katoen Natie warehouses in Ghent.

Profile

• You have experience with a forklift truck with long forks (2m40) or you have extensive experience with a forklift truck with short forks and you see yourself driving the long-fork truck as well.

• A forklift certificate is not a requirement, experience is more important. There will be a theoretical and practical test

• To communicate effectively with your colleagues, you speak and understand Dutch or English well.

• You can work in a two-shift system

• You are motivated and reliable, and you prize safety and quality.

• You are flexible when it comes to hours and tasks

• In addition, you know how to use a scanner and a computer

Ready to start straight away in a full-time meat production role near Oosterzele, with no weekend shifts? Explore this opportunity in food production.

A food production workplace focused on meat products.

What you’ll do

• Help process meat products as part of the production work.
• Weigh products carefully.
• Pack products ready for the next stage.
Your working week runs from 6:00 am to 3:00 pm, Monday to Thursday, and from 6:00 am to 12:15 pm on Friday.

Forum Jobs connects people and businesses through a personal approach and broad knowledge across sectors. As a full-service HR partner, it supports both candidates and employers, bringing that understanding to each recruitment opportunity.

If you enjoy practical work and are ready to get started, this could be a great fit for you.

• Previous experience in meat production is welcome, but your enthusiasm to learn matters too.
• You feel physically ready for hands-on work throughout the day.
• Working in a cool environment of 4–7°C is something you’re comfortable with.
• You can speak and read Dutch, English or French well enough to use one of these languages at work.
• You’re available to start immediately and can arrange your own transport, as public transport does not reach the workplace.

Do you want to wrap up our team?
 

Tropack is a family business, active as an industrial supplier and service provider. Our core business? Storing and packing goods, parts and spare parts for the non-food sector. This with a big smile, for more than 30 years.
 

As a close team, we offer new employees a warm second home. Short lines of communication and a human approach are key for us.
 

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an quality Inspector Exchange.
 

Location: Oostakker
 

What will be your responsibilities as an inspector?
 
 

• You check and sort used goods. 

• You find out which part it is: type of part, serial number, etc. 

• You perform a visual quality check based on instructions provided. 

• You record the necessary data per part in the computer system. 

• You store the parts in the predefined location after making the right decision. 

• You move goods using a stacker. 

• You report to your team leader. 
 

• You are a motivated employee who likes to roll up your sleeves and don’t mind getting dirty. 

• You enjoy working independently and know how to make proactive adjustments where necessary.  

• Working with a computer? No problem! 

• You can work at a fast pace and attaches great importance to delivering quality.  

• You are available to work full-time in shifts. One week, you will work from 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM, and the following week from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM. 

• Fluent in English or Dutch.

If you enjoy working on real robots in real environments and want to see your software operating in 
the field, this role offers the opportunity to make a tangible impact in a fast-growing and innovative 
sector.
 

This is what your job will look like:
 

As a robotic engineer, you will be part of our driven engineering team, where you will work together to 
develop high-quality software solutions. Your tasks will include:
 
 

• Develop, maintain, and improve robotic software using 
ROS2 

• Integrate and optimize 
navigation stacks, SLAM, and sensor fusion 

• Build perception systems using 
Computer Vision (e.g., object detection, visual localization) 

• Design and deploy 
Machine Learning models for robotic perception and autonomous decisionmaking 

• Work hands-on with real robots: system integration, deployment, tuning, and performance 
optimization 

• Contribute to robot control, localization, and path planning 

• Participate in on-site testing and customer deployments across Belgium and the Netherlands  

That's why this job suits you:
 
 

• You are hands-on and have 3-5 years of experience and strong affinity with autonomous navigation, robotics, machine control or industrial automation 

• Thorough knowledge of 
ROS2, C, C++, and Python 

• Solid knowledge in majority of the following fields: 
 

• Sensor fusion for state estimation and localization 

• Control systems for robotics 

• Path planning & Navigation (SLAM) 

• Computer Vision and Machine Learning applied to robotics   

• You’re comfortable working with hardware and in realworld field environments and experience bringing systems from prototype to reliable field deployment 

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your work 

• You have a valid EU driving license (for site testing and deployments) 

• You can communicate fluently in English

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.As part of our growth (RAMP UP) of LEAP engines, we are looking for a CNC Operator to strengthen our teams.

As experienced CNC machine operator, you will oversee our computer numeric controlled (CNC) machines. You will be responsible for ensuring machining of subassembly, quality parts and tools specific to engineering drawings dimensions.Your Role :

• Set up and operate CNC machines to perform various tasks, including drilling, grinding, and milling.
• Ensure CNC machines operate in compliance with company guidelines and safety standards.
• Monitor machines during operation and make necessary adjustments to optimize results.
• Inspect machinery daily to ensure proper functionality.
• Record all machine activities by completing production and quality logs.
• Provide accurate timelines and updates to clients.
• Communicate with the Methods Department regarding any issues encountered during machining.
• Ensure that machining results meet the defined work scope and quality expectations.
• Conduct regular assessments and maintenance of CNC machines.

Your Profile:

• High school diploma or equivalent qualification required.
• Minimum of 3 years of experience as a CNC machine operator.
• Ability to read and interpret mechanical documents and engineering drawings.
• Strong mechanical aptitude.
• Excellent attention to detail and a goal-oriented attitude.
• Strong comprehension and analytical skills.
• Knowledge of the latest equipment and techniques in the industry.
• Good computer skills.
• You have a very knowledge of technical English and a basic understanding of Dutch or French, with the desire to improve it.
• Willingness to work in a 3-shift system
 

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

To strengthen our Supply Chain Team we are looking for a Configuration & Logistics Officer who ensures that for a given engine, the pieces are made available for assembly within the configuration and timeframe agreed with the customer.Your role:

• You will analyse and provide the logistical needs to complete the engine.
• You read and understand the logistical aspects of the Bill of Work for the engine.
• You detect critical points in the completion process and look for an appropriate solution to achieve the objectives (e.g. Standard Exchanges, switches between different engines).
• You direct your internal suppliers (warehouse, backshop, subcontracting, purchasing).
• You complete the modules and ensure that they are prepared according to the predetermined production planning.
• You support the assembly line with missing and/or defective parts.
• You analyse the interchangeability (technical and qualitative) of pieces, in accordance with the established configuration.

Your profile:

• You have a Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain or a technical direction, or equivalent through experience.
• You have an interest in aircraft engines and want to learn more about them.
• You are communicative and dare to ask questions.
• You work in a structured, accurate and proactive way.
• You work analytically and come up with practical solutions.
• You organize, divide and control your work independently.
• You speak French or Dutch, you also have a good knowledge of technical English.
• Experience with SAP is a plus.
• You work in shifts, from Monday to Friday (6 am - 2 pm, 2 pm - 10 pm).
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

The Logistic Warehouse Officer is responsible for the physical flow, the IT flow and the traceability of parts and modules in the preparation area before assembly and in the warehouse. He works in a production environment and reports to the Completion Manager, who in turn reports to the Supply Chain Director.Your role:

• You provide logistical support for production, where needed, and anticipate the needs for the realization of the 'Shop Visit' of modules and engines.
• You manage the incoming flow of engine parts in production by ensuring their traceability.
• You ensure the management of priorities vis-à-vis the modules to be prepared and released.
• You guarantee the cleanliness and correct packaging of the parts in the store.
• You follow the work and safety instructions specific to the workstation and the company.
• You respect the internal quality regulations and the rules of logistics and administrative management of the company.
• You stimulate the sharing of knowledge in the group.
• You take initiatives and make proposals in the context of continuous improvement, pro-actively evaluate, coordinate the improvement of current work methods and new technologies as they arise.You maintain constructive and effective relations with production, configurators and other colleagues.

Your profile:

• You hold a higher secondary or technical education degree or have equivalent experience, with a basic understanding of logistics. A degree in logistics or a related field is a strong advantage.
• You are proficient in IT tools (Word, Excel, ERP) and hold a valid license for lifting equipment.
• You strive to become fully operational and autonomous within six months, following a period of training and learning.
• You possess strong communication skills, practical thinking, and initiative, while actively contributing to continuous improvement efforts.
• You are a team player with an open and adaptable mindset.
• You work in a two-shift system: one week from 6 a.m. to 2 p.m., followed by a week from 2 p.m. to 10 p.m.
• You are fluent in either French or Dutch, have at least a basic understanding of the second national language, and with a good level of English.
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

Join a collaborative IT team where you can solve problems, explore new technologies and grow technically from day one.

Our partner is a growing professional services organisation looking for a hands-onSupport Engineerto join its collaborative IT team.

This is more than a traditional support role: you'll work alongside experienced IT professionals, discover new technologies and gradually take on more technical responsibilities. If you're curious, proactive and eager to learn, this is your chance to build a strong technical career in an environment where teamwork and personal development go hand in hand.
Support Engineer - Your Role
• IT Support:Act as the first point of contact for colleagues, troubleshoot technical issues and ensure efficient ticket follow-up.
• Hardware & Workplace:Configure laptops, mobile devices and IT equipment, while supporting onboarding and offboarding processes.
• Microsoft 365:Help users get the most out of Microsoft 365 applications and digital workplace tools.
• Digital Innovation:ExploreAI, automation and emerging technologies, contributing to smarter tools and more efficient internal processes.
• Technical Development:Collaborate closely with experienced IT colleagues and System Engineers, progressively expanding your technical knowledge and responsibilities.
• Team Collaboration:Connect with colleagues across different offices and contribute to a consistent, high-quality IT experience throughout the organisation.
Support Engineer - Your Profile
• Education:A Bachelor's or Graduate degree in IT, Computer Science, ICT or a related field; graduates and junior profiles are welcome.
• Technical Curiosity:A genuine interest inMicrosoft 365, AI, automation and digital innovation, with the motivation to keep learning.
• Problem-Solving:A practical, hands-on mindset and the ability to analyse issues and find effective solutions.
• Soft Skills:Strong communication skills, a service-oriented attitude and a genuine enjoyment of helping others.
• Languages:ExcellentDutch, with a good knowledge ofEnglish and French.
• Mobility & Mindset:A proactive, team-oriented attitude and willingness to travel between offices when needed. A Category B driving licenceis an asset.

Do you like to work in the heart of Gent city? We're looking for you!

Together with functional experts, scrum masters, UX designers and other developers, you

will work in an inspiring, high-paced and fun environment. We work on software projects

according to the agile methodology (SCRUM) and in close collaboration with our customers.
Role
As a Java developer your input will help shape the future of the company, we will count on

you to coach other developers and steer our approach for various projects.

You are able to work closely together with the business, willing to go the extra mile and love

to tackle new challenges. You get excited about new technologies and are always eager to

learn more.

Profile
• You have at least 3 years of relevant experience in any of the following technologies:

Java, Spring Boot framework, NodeJS, designing and implementing RESTful API’s

• Also interested in frontend development? We work mostly with Angular, React and

React Native.

• Experience with Google Cloud Platform, Azure or AWS is a plus

• You are able to help set up the architecture for our projects, selecting the right

technologies to serve the business need and review UI designs

• You are willing to develop yourself and learn new technologies

• You are fluent in English + Dutch or French is a must.

Software Engineer Vacancy
 

Are you passionate about building innovative digital solutions? Devatwork is looking for a talented Fullstack Engineer to join our dynamic team. If you think you are a match, we want to hear from you!
 

What You'll Do:
 

● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain scalable web and mobile applications
 

● Develop both front-end and back-end solutions
 

● Communicate with clients to understand their pain points and offer solutions
 

● Ensure optimal performance, security, and responsiveness across all platforms
 

● Work with cloud services and databases
 

● Be a leader in your field, and help others grow with you
 

What We're Looking For:
 

● Strong proficiency in Full Stack Development
 

● Have at least 2 years of professional experience
 

● Experience with React, Vue.js, Angular, or similar front-end frameworks
 

● Solid knowledge of Node.js, Django, Laravel, or other back-end technologies
 

● Knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases
 

● Knowledge of version control systems (git or others)

 

● Be able to work on multiple projects simultaneously

 

● Ability to master technologies/tools on request

 

● Understanding of Enterprise Level Architectures

 

● English speaking, Dutch or French are strong assets

 

● Be open to be working in Ghent, Belgium 4 days a week in the office

 

Preferred Skills:
 

● Experience leading small teams

 

● Understanding of DevOps tools and CI/CD pipelines is a plus

 

● Knowledge of CMS Solutions (Drupal, WordPress and others)

What will you do?

• You will assist our customers with architecture and design of high available, secure and scalable Integration solutions using Azure Integration Services such as Logic Apps & Azure Functions
• It’s important that you can assist our customers with architecture and design of API & Microservice solutions on Microsoft Azure
• You will implement complex integration solutions with focus on availability, scalability and security
• It’s important that you stay up to date with the latest changes of the Azure ecosystem
• You don’t mind getting your hands dirty and perform Development and DevOps tasks

Who are we looking for?

• Minimum bachelor’s degree with at least 3 years of experience as an Azure Integration Architect
• Coding experience using .NET (Core)
• Knowledge and practical experience of/with Azure Integration Services, API Design & Azure API Management
• The Azure Identity management (AD, ADB2C, …) ecosystem has no secrets for you.
• You have experience with working in an Agile way
• Knowledge and practical experience with Microservice oriented solutions, Docker and the Azure Kubernetes ecosystem is a huge plus
• You are able to coach and guide your colleagues and our customers
• Knowledge of Azure Monitor and analytics
• You have good English & Dutch communication skills
